methodology: Primary-authority addendum for high-consequence legal rules. Prefer current U.S. Code, eCFR, and official agency forms/guidance. This supplements data/sources.json without replacing it.

authorities.title: 38 CFR § 3.155 — How to file a claim
authorities.claim: Intent-to-file treatment applies under the conditions in § 3.155(b) and does not apply to Supplemental Claims.

authorities.title: 38 CFR § 3.400 — General effective-date rules
authorities.claim: Effective dates are governed by claim type and statutory/regulatory exceptions; no universal statement that an Intent to File automatically locks an effective date is safe.

authorities.title: 38 CFR § 3.2500 — Review of decisions
authorities.claim: HLR and Board review generally use the one-year election period, while Supplemental Claims may be filed later; continuous pursuit affects effective dates.

authorities.title: 38 CFR § 3.2501 — Supplemental claims
authorities.claim: A Supplemental Claim may be filed after notice of a prior decision and generally requires new and relevant evidence for readjudication.

authorities.title: 10 U.S.C. § 1552(b) — Correction of military records
authorities.claim: Correction requests are generally subject to a three-year period from discovery of the error or injustice; a board may excuse late filing in the interest of justice.

authorities.title: VA Form 20-0995 — Supplemental Claim
authorities.claim: Prescribed VA form for Supplemental Claims.

authorities.title: VA Form 20-0996 — Higher-Level Review
authorities.claim: Prescribed VA form for Higher-Level Review.

authorities.title: VA Form 10182 — Board Appeal
authorities.claim: Prescribed VA form for Board Appeal (Notice of Disagreement).

authorities.title: VA Form 20-0998 — Your Right to Seek Review of Our Decision
authorities.claim: Explains review rights for covered VA decisions and directs claimants to the applicable prescribed review form.

authorities.title: VA Form 21-0966 — Intent to File
authorities.claim: Official Intent to File form; effect depends on satisfying the governing rules and timely filing a qualifying complete claim.

authorities.title: VA — Getting emergency care at non-VA facilities
authorities.claim: Veterans should not delay emergency treatment for VA authorization; VA asks to be notified within 72 hours, and late notice is not an automatic payment denial.

authorities.title: 38 CFR § 17.4010 — Veteran eligibility for Community Care
authorities.claim: Defines conditions under which a covered Veteran may elect authorized Community Care.

authorities.title: VA Patient Advocate Program
authorities.claim: Patient Advocates help Veterans address concerns about VA health care and patient rights.

authorities.title: VA Privacy Act Requests
authorities.claim: Individuals may seek access to their VA Privacy Act records and request amendment of records alleged to be inaccurate, incomplete, untimely, or irrelevant.

authorities.title: 38 U.S.C. § 1151 — Benefits for persons disabled by VA treatment or vocational rehabilitation
authorities.claim: Creates a VA benefits remedy for qualifying additional disability or death under specified causation and proximate-cause conditions.

authorities.title: 38 CFR § 3.361 — Benefits under 38 U.S.C. 1151
authorities.claim: Implements causation, additional-disability, proximate-cause, fault, informed-consent, and unforeseeable-event rules for modern §1151 claims.

authorities.title: 28 U.S.C. § 2401(b) — FTCA time limits
authorities.claim: Generally requires presentment of a tort claim to the appropriate federal agency within two years after accrual and suit within six months after mailing of final denial.

authorities.title: 28 U.S.C. § 2675 — FTCA administrative exhaustion
authorities.claim: Generally requires administrative presentment and final denial, or six months without final disposition, before an FTCA action is instituted.

authorities.title: VA Office of General Counsel — Claims Under the Federal Tort Claims Act
authorities.claim: VA explains FTCA presentment requirements, sum-certain requirement, current filing channels, and that SF 95 is convenient but not mandatory if the written presentment otherwise satisfies requirements.

authorities.title: DOJ Civil Division — Standard Form 95
authorities.claim: SF 95 is the standard administrative tort claim form and a valid presentment must state a sum certain.

authorities.title: VA Legal Services for Veterans (LSV-H)
authorities.claim: LSV-H funds legal services for eligible Veterans who are homeless or at risk for homelessness; service scope varies by grantee.

authorities.title: VA OGC Accreditation Search
authorities.claim: Official search for currently VA-accredited attorneys, claims agents, and VSO representatives and recognized VSOs.
